project.form: Form 8889 line 6 for spouses with separate HSAs
project.remedy: Count the months treated as family coverage the same way for both spouses (if either had family coverage while both were eligible, both are treated as having it), use the same allocation method on both Forms 8889, and allocate no more than the Step 1 limit between you. An agreed allocation between spouses whose Step 1 limits differ is outside this tool.
